items.name: R2 scope, process route, CP4 gate and full-lld inputs are ready
items.notes: R2 only repairs F02 consumer-side and F03; R1 result remains immutable and this result supersedes it.

items.name: R2 keeps heterogeneous-leg acceptance coverage and adds publication invariants
items.notes: Target/authz/fresh-proof/no-main/no-sibling/no-cross-leg requirements remain; F02/F03 add nested health and published-handle proofs.

items.name: Source-default and artifact-integration policy remains aligned with HLD and ADR
items.notes: Artifact main/default remains unreachable and aggregate/projection ownership remains ST-AW-004.

items.name: F02 consumer uses the Lane B frozen nested observation port only
items.notes: Artifact precheck only reads health.observation; HEALTHY requires non-null observation and exact recomputed observation digest match; copied flat health fields are forbidden.

items.name: Immutable LegResultPayload has a prewrite digest and no append-time self-reference
items.notes: Payload excludes its own result_ref, append/write receipt, receipt_digest, writer_id and written_at; canonical digest is determined before writer invocation.

items.name: External receipt and runtime PublishedLegResultHandle close F03 without payload rewrite
items.notes: LegResultWriter writes the immutable payload once and returns external receipt; handle is runtime/evidence-index composition and is never persisted back into payload.

items.name: Writer failure cannot publish a PASS handle and evidence-only retry never reruns Git
items.notes: Failure returns UnpublishedLegResultOutcome/evidence-pending; retry submits byte-identical payload and single-write key with Git calls fixed at zero.

items.name: ST-AW-004 receives only reread-validatable published handles
items.notes: Validator rereads payload from result_ref and checks receipt/ref/payload digest/receipt digest/derived key/correlation; raw or unpublished input is rejected.

items.name: Primary, read-only and forbidden file boundaries remain deterministic
items.notes: R2 changed only Lane C allowed design/story/check files; no source, test, shared plan/state/ledger/checkpoint or other Story writes.

items.name: Single-write key, same-digest idempotency and conflicting-digest rejection are explicit
items.notes: Same key and digest returns the same external receipt; same key with different digest blocks; payload append count remains one.

items.name: Nested health fail-closed, typed authz and no-forbidden-mutation boundaries are preserved
items.notes: Unknown/null/mismatched health never authorizes mutation; main/sibling/reset/clean/stash/rebase/force/cross-leg mutation remains zero.

items.name: F02/F03 consumer, payload, receipt, handle and retry failure paths have deterministic tests
items.notes: TP-AW03-017..020 and TP-03-019..021 cover forbidden fields, digest timing, tamper rejection, nested health, unpublished outcomes and Git=0 retry.

items.name: Development gate remains closed and computable
items.notes: Story remains ready-for-review, confirmed=false and dependencies_satisfied=false; R2 PASS neither approves CP5 nor authorizes Git/source implementation.

items.name: F02/F03 repair adds no unresolved user decision or waiver
items.notes: Clarification queue remains clear; findings are implementability defects with a fixed repair contract, not a new scope/architecture choice.

items.name: Feature design, test plan, Story card and full LLD are mutually aligned
items.notes: All four artifacts use the same health.observation and payload -> external receipt -> published handle contract.

items.name: ST-AW-003 R2 full LLD is structurally valid and ready for independent re-review
items.notes: lld-check returned OK; R2 supersedes R1, keeps confirmed=false and routes to CP5 R2 batch independent review.
